title: Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.01619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic report

translated_title: 揭示深度学习音频开发的成本
translated_abstract: 深度学习对环境的影响在过去十年中受到越来越多的关注。现有研究主要聚焦于模型训练和推理阶段的能耗与碳排放，而整个开发阶段往往被忽视。然而，在这一阶段需要进行架构原型设计和密集实验，其能耗需求非常高。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于LORIA实验室所使用的Grid5000共享计算平台活动日志来估算这些成本的方法。作为案例研究，我们聚焦于Multispeech研究团队开发的音频项目。我们评估了四个项目的总体能耗成本，并将其与训练已发表模型的能耗进行了比较。我们的结果表明，开发阶段所需的能量是单独训练表现最佳模型所需能量的3至256倍。这些结果呼吁建立更系统化的报告机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Grid5000共享计算平台活动日志来估算深度学习音频开发阶段能耗的方法，并通过案例研究发现开发阶段的能耗是单独训练最佳模型的3至256倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a methodology to estimate the energy cost of the deep learning audio development phase based on Grid5000 activity logs, revealing that development consumes 3 to 256 times more energy than training the best-performing model alone.
